subject: fruit fly
title: A Killer Was Hiding Inside the World's Favourite Lab Insect

scenes.text: A killer was hiding inside the world's favourite lab insect.
In 2023, scientists checking backyard fruit flies in Mississippi found larvae inside them.
A tiny wasp, new to science, had laid an egg straight into a living, adult fly.
For about eighteen days, the larva grows inside the fly, while the fly lives on.
Then it bursts out through the side of the fly's abdomen.
Two hundred years of studying wasps that attack flies, and nobody had seen this. It was in backyards all along.

description:
Syntretus perlmani, a parasitoid wasp new to science, was found in 2023 in backyard fruit flies in Mississippi and later in Alabama and North Carolina.
It is the first known to lay its egg in adult fruit flies; the larva grows inside for about 18 days, then exits through the side of the abdomen.
What else is hiding in your backyard?
first_comment: Its DNA had even turned up in public genetic data from lab fruit flies, but nobody had spotted it. Scientists think it lives across the eastern United States. Ever seen one?
